## Type of Change

- [ ] `feat`: A new feature
- [ ] `fix`: A bug fix
- [ ] `refactor`: A code change that neither fixes a bug nor adds a feature
- [ ] `perf`: A code change that improves performance
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation updates or additions
- [ ] `test`: Adding missing tests or correcting existing tests
- [ ] `chore`: Changes to build process or auxiliary tools and libraries

## Architectural Impact

- [ ] State Management (Riverpod providers/notifiers modified)

- [ ] UI / Presentation (Widgets, screens, or theme styling changed)
- [ ] Cloud Sync / Networking (Google Drive sync, Dio client, or Cloudflare Worker affected)
- [ ] None / Documentation only
